title: Private suite in Nashville neighborhood
description:
Private-entrance guest suite just steps away from your free driveway parking space. Tucked in a neighborhood with low traffic, and conveniently located close to the airport. This comfortable suite offers easy access to all neighborhoods and popular Nashville tourist destinations. Perfect if you are passing through Nashville or want a quiet place to come back to after a night on the town. 

This guest suite is fully permitted by the city of Nashville: STRP2019followedby057886

The space
The suite offers a private, separate entrance with a private bedroom and private bath.  A comfortable sitting area and coffee table gives you space to spread out and relax. There is a laptop-ready desk and excellent wifi connectivity. This room is part of my home and I live here. I kindly ask that guests are respectful of quite hours: 10:00pm - 8:00am and do not abuse the space.

This is a no pet and no smoking place. Guests who violate this will be charged a $100 additional cleaning fee.
